qualityGate.reason: The test compiles and uses Playwright APIs without errors, and properly awaits asynchronous operations. It preserves the testCaseId in the test title and asserts that product cards count is greater than zero. However, selectors rely on hardcoded data-test attributes with numbered suffixes which can be brittle and hard to maintain. The summation of counts involves many repeated locator calls instead of a more scalable approach. Assertions are limited to count > 0 without validating expected count or specific product visibility. There are no navigation or interaction validations. Overall the test is executable and correct but has limited assertion strength and maintainability concerns.
